description: Ranks A-shares by collateral-eligible holdings (担保券) for one trading day (default latest). Default `pct_desc` = `collateral_pct_of_total_mv` (collateral value as % of total cap, percentage points) — how much of a name sits in margin accounts and is exposed to forced liquidation. Other keys: `pct_asc`, `shares_chg_desc` / `shares_chg_asc`, `mv_desc`. Rows with an unpublished ranking field are excluded, not zero. **T+1, published later than margin data** — may lag `margin_movers` by a day. ⚠️ Noisy on small caps — check `collateral_mv_cny`. Coverage is wider than the margin list.

_fields.description: 逗号分隔的直接字段；有 items 时投影每行，否则投影 data；外层字段或嵌套结构用 _jq

_intent.description: 用户原问题一句话，仅分析用，可留空

_jq.description: JMESPath，对 data 求值（写 items[*].id）

_max_bytes.description: 响应字节上限，默认约 50 KB

_max_bytes_mode.description: 正文超限处理，默认 truncate 保留前缀

_spill.description: true=全量落盘，只回摘要与取数地址

limit.description: Number of rows to return (1-200, default 30)

sort.description: Ranking key: pct_desc (default) / pct_asc / shares_chg_desc / shares_chg_asc / mv_desc

trade_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to the latest trading day present in the data.

name: margin_collateral_movers
